chain.label: Captain proceeded to takeoff without having the airplane deiced despite freezing-precipitation exposure

chain.label: Localized airflow separation on contaminated upper wing surface produced asymmetric stall shortly after liftoff
chain.trigger: the accident airplane failed to establish a positive rate of climb shortly after liftoff and began to roll because of localized airflow separation on the wing due to upper wing surface contamination

caused_by.evidence: The presence of upper wing surface contamination is likely because the airplane was parked on the ground for about 40 to 45 minutes during freezing precipitation and it was not deiced
the captain failed to have the airplane deiced prior for takeoff

chain.label: Airplane rolled abruptly left-right-left within 3.5 seconds, unresponsive to control input
chain.trigger: the airplane rolled abruptly left, right, and left...large roll rates that are not responsive to control inputs

caused_by.evidence: Once localized airflow separation begins on a portion of a contaminated wing, that wing can stall before the other one, which results in lift asymmetry and large roll rates

chain.label: Left wingtip and fuselage struck the ground; airplane slid ~1,390 feet with postcrash fire
chain.trigger: the left wingtip then collided with the ground followed by the fuselage. The airplane slid along the ground for about 1,390 feet, and a postcrash fire ensued

caused_by.evidence: the crash occurred within only 3.7 seconds of the "bank angle" warning

chain.label: Captain, flight attendant, and one passenger killed; first officer and two passengers seriously injured
chain.trigger: the captain, the flight attendant, and one passenger were killed, and the first officer and two passengers were seriously injured

caused_by.evidence: The airplane was destroyed by impact forces and postcrash fire
